purpose: Join explicit named-value Operation realizations to the existing Workflow call, settlement and recovery contracts without inventing domain relationships or a second workflow runtime.
call_boundary: Accept only genuine checked composed Operation actions from the exact Workflow graph, composition boundary and field compilation. Every occurrence pins the full action digest, including its value composition. The existing action-only compiler remains action-only.
signature: The existing closed Workflow binding vocabulary describes ordinary inputs, opaque Event inputs and success results. Query and Mapping intermediate values remain private to the Operation. No computed value becomes a Workflow caller input. Existing type equality, occurrence availability and exact operation coverage remain mandatory.
checked_artifact: Reuse the checked Workflow call-closure artifact with an explicit composition_contract_sha256 extension included in its hash. Registration proves static call closure only. The old action-only path emits unchanged artifact fields.
generation: Consume a genuine composed Operation artifact plan from the exact graph, fields and boundary. Its modules exactly cover all forward and compensation operation references with their complete action digests. Generate the existing native Workflow materialization and forward orchestrator around these native imports. Preserve complete dependency artifacts and reject path collisions.
settlement: Existing ordered forward calls and awaited settlement remain unchanged. Each composed call carries a finite precommit stage/code vocabulary derived from its checked named bindings and explicit absence codes. Generation must match that vocabulary to the exact composed Operation plan. Only failed envelopes matching those exact stage/code pairs extend the existing settlement checker; unrelated codes, stages, rejected combinations and malformed envelopes remain indeterminate. A precommit Query or Mapping failure cannot be treated as success. Unknown commit requires reconciliation. No retry or compensation is executed automatically.
recovery: The explicitly selected existing needed-compensations-only and reverse-completion policy remains unchanged. Compensation plans retain the full composed action identities and dependencies. An intent is not execution or durability proof.
compatibility: Additive explicit binding and generation entry points; no change to authored Workflow occurrence semantics, existing action-only generation or old pinned contract bytes. Public project and CLI integration remain separate work.
